versions.content: When all ComMUsers assigned to this PNC request “No Communication”, the sub state COMM_PNC_REQUESTED shall be left and the sub state COMM_PNC_READY_SLE EP shall be entered, if ComMPncGatewayEnabled Specification of Communication Manager AUTOSAR CP R21 - 11 43 of 192 Document ID 79 : AUTOSAR_SWS_COMManager is set to FALSE or ComMPncGatewayType is not set on all channels which are referenced by this PNC.

When all ComMUsers assigned to this PNC request “No Communication”, the sub state COMM_PNC_REQUESTED shall be left and the sub state COMM_PNC_READY_SLE EP shall be entered, if ComMPncGatewayEnabled is set to FALSE or ComMPncGatewayType is not set on all channels which are referenced by this PNC.
